signature.name: VTask.Fibration
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> (rα : α → α → Prop) -> (rβ : β → β → Prop) -> (f : α → β) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.Fibration is a universally quantified Prop with no junk-value or degenerate-input conventions; it is well-formed for all inputs and vacuously true when rβ is empty.

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} (rα : α → α → Prop) (rβ : β → β → Prop) (f : α → β), VTask.Fibration rα rβ f → ∀ a : α, Acc rα a → Acc rβ (f a)

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} [LE α] [LE β] (f : α → β), VTask.Fibration (· ≤ ·) (· ≤ ·) f → ∀ s : Set α, IsLowerSet s → IsLowerSet (f '' s)

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [LE β] (f : α → β), VTask.Fibration (· ≤ ·) (· ≤ ·) f ↔ ∀ x : α, IsLowerSet (f '' Set.Iic x)

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Type*} (rα : α → α → Prop) (rβ : β → β → Prop) (rγ : γ → γ → Prop) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ), VTask.Fibration rα rβ f → VTask.Fibration rβ rγ g → VTask.Fibration rα rγ (g ∘ f)

facts.statement: ¬ VTask.Fibration (fun (n m : ℕ) => n < m) (fun (n m : ℕ) => n < m) (fun n => 2 * n)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.violated_property: Every rβ-predecessor of f a must be in the image of f with a matching rα-predecessor; 1 < 2 = f 1 but 1 is not in the image of fun n => 2 * n

facts.statement: ¬ VTask.Fibration (fun (n m : ℕ) => n + 2 = m) (fun (n m : ℕ) => n + 1 = m) id

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.instance: VTask.Fibration (fun n m : ℕ => n + 2 = m) (fun n m : ℕ => n + 1 = m) id
facts.violated_property: rβ is not contained in rα: 0 + 1 = 1 holds under rβ but the only rα-predecessor of 1 satisfying id n' = 0 would require n' + 2 = 1, which is impossible
